prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game walking animation sprite sheet, one character, exactly 8 frames arranged in a perfectly uniform 4-column by 2-row grid. Reference 1 is the existing four-character walking sheet; use only the matching Haneul character for design and rendering style. Reference 2 is this character's identity portrait. Create a genuinely transparent RGBA background. No floor, no shadows, no text, no labels, no guide lines, no decorative effects. Canvas 2048x1024, each invisible cell 512x512. Haneul: brown tousled hair, red scarf trailing slightly backwards, blue jacket over cream hoodie, navy shorts, dark blue sneakers, small brown backpack. Preserve exactly the reference face, hair, clothing, colors, proportions, chibi adventure-game hand-painted pixel-edged sprite style. Full body in EVERY cell, facing RIGHT in a constant side/three-quarter profile. Face must never turn away. Same orthographic camera, same scale and head shape. Each body centered around cell x=256, shoe contact ground at y=450, generous 48px minimum outer safety gutters. Do not use independent poses; draw ONE physically coherent continuous walk cycle over eight equally spaced moments in time. Read frames left-to-right top-to-bottom: 0 near/right leg forward heel contact far/left leg back toe, 1 weight-down near leg planted far leg beginning swing, 2 far leg passes under hip near supporting leg nearly straight, 3 far leg extends forward near leg pushes off, 4 mirrored foot contact with far leg forward near leg back, 5 weight-down far leg planted near leg beginning swing, 6 near leg passes under hip far supporting leg straight, 7 near leg extends forward far leg pushes off; then smoothly loops back to 0. Both legs and shoes visible and distinguishable, no duplicated feet. Arms swing gently opposite the legs; head and torso remain almost still with only 2-4 pixels natural rise; hip remains same horizontal position. Scarf/ponytail/backpack secondary movement subtle. No running leap, no speed lines, no huge limb spread. No squash/stretch, no identity changes, no abrupt angle changes, no extra objects. In Haneul's last frame preserve the same face and accessories as in the first. This sheet will be played as 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,0 continuously, so draw genuine in-between motion.
